purpose: Anchored district tile map for SCENE recomposition: tiles, tile_size, and transitions copied VERBATIM from pinned data/zones/district.json. Consumed OPT-IN by track_recompose scene builders (load_zone_map) - the tile layer draws floor/wall/transition cells with the banked draw_floor_tile/draw_wall_tile/draw_gold_tile conventions over the anchored district palette. Never a runtime fetch.

value_citations.tiles: data/zones/district.json tiles - 26 row strings copied verbatim; glyph census '.' and '#' only
value_citations.transitions: data/zones/district.json transitions - copied verbatim; the scene consumes 'at' only and draws every transition cell with the unsealed gold convention (seal/lock state is runtime state a track does not carry; disclosed)
value_citations.glyph_wall: '#' = wall: renderer.rb:432 collects wall runs via map.wall?; the '#' law comment renderer.rb:259
value_citations.glyph_floor: '.' = plain floor: renderer.rb draw_map (279+) paints the whole map floor-first; plain cells carry no typed overlay
value_citations.transition_draw: gold rect inset 3 over floor: renderer.rb:349 (unsealed branch) = the banked draw_gold_tile convention (tools/make_contact_sheet.py)

anchoring.not_modeled: stations, decor, motif rects, ambient tint, seal/lock slab states, the engine's full-map grid lines over walls (the banked draw_floor_tile draws grid on each floor tile's top/left edge only), drop-gradient markers - disclosed in the scene artifacts
